**Methodological description (English):** Using qualitative models, distinguish the invariant speed of light in vacuum for inertial observers from ordinary addition of speeds of everyday objects.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends que la vitesse de la lumière dans le vide est invariante pour tous les observateurs inertiels en relativité restreinte.

### Physique moléculaire

Groups: 3 · Skills: 10

[molecularPhysics.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/molecularPhysics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Particle models help explain physical properties and changes in states of matter. Unlike chemistry, this Domain focuses on particle movement, interactions, and arrangement rather than chemical reactions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment le mouvement et la disposition des particules expliquent le comportement de la matière.

#### Diffusion et mélange

Skills: 1

[diffusionAndMixing.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/diffusionAndMixing/diffusionAndMixing.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Random thermal motion can cause particles to spread gradually without deliberate stirring.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment le mouvement aléatoire des particules entraîne la diffusion et le mélange des substances.

##### Expliquer la diffusion

[explainDiffusion.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/diffusionAndMixing/skills/explainDiffusion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Diffusion results from particles' thermal motion and the gradual equalization of their concentrations without the need for macroscopic mixing.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment la diffusion peut se produire sans agitation.

#### Propriétés des gaz

Skills: 2

[gasProperties.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/gasProperties/gasProperties.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The compressibility of gases and the dependence of their pressure on conditions follow from particle motion and the spaces between particles.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les propriétés physiques des gaz grâce au modèle particulaire.

##### Expliquer la compressibilité des gaz

[explainGasCompressibility.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/gasProperties/skills/explainGasCompressibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compressing a gas reduces the average distances between particles while the sizes of the molecules remain virtually unchanged.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi un gaz peut être comprimé dans un volume plus petit.

##### Expliquer le lien entre pression et température d’un gaz à volume constant

[explainHowGasPressureDependsOnTemperatureAtConstantVolume.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/gasProperties/skills/explainHowGasPressureDependsOnTemperatureAtConstantVolume.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** At constant volume, increasing a gas's temperature generally increases its pressure because the particles move more vigorously.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique pourquoi la pression du gaz augmente avec la température si son volume reste constant.

#### Modèle particulaire de la matière

Skills: 7

[particleModelOfMatter.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/particleModelOfMatter.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Substances consist of particles with spaces and interactions between them; the model explains properties without requiring complex formulas.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment des particules invisibles interagissent pour former les substances.

##### Comparer la disposition des particules dans les solides, liquides et gaz

[compareParticleArrangementsInSolidsLiquidsAndGases.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/skills/compareParticleArrangementsInSolidsLiquidsAndGases.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Particles in solids mostly oscillate around fixed positions; in liquids, particles can move relative to one another; and in gases they have much greater freedom of movement and characteristic interparticle distances.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare la façon dont les particules sont disposées dans les solides, liquides et gaz.

##### Expliquer la pression du gaz par le mouvement des particules

[explainGasPressureThroughParticleMotion.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/skills/explainGasPressureThroughParticleMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The combined collisions of particles with the vessel walls produce force per unit area, that is, pressure.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment les nombreuses collisions des particules avec une paroi créent une pression.

##### Expliquer l’agitation thermique aléatoire des particules

[explainRandomThermalMotionOfParticles.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/skills/explainRandomThermalMotionOfParticles.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Particles of matter are constantly moving, but not all at the same speed; the type of motion depends on the physical state.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi les particules bougent sans cesse de façons et à des vitesses variées.

##### Expliquer la structure particulaire de la matière

[explainTheParticulateStructureOfMatter.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/skills/explainTheParticulateStructureOfMatter.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Demonstrate that even water in a transparent glass consists of particles invisible to the naked eye.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique pourquoi la matière est constituée de particules trop petites pour être vues directement.

##### Expliquer les propriétés des états de la matière par le mouvement des particules

[explainThePropertiesOfStatesOfMatterThroughParticleMotion.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/skills/explainThePropertiesOfStatesOfMatterThroughParticleMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Differences in the arrangement, motion, and interactions of particles explain the properties of solids, liquids, and gases.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise le mouvement et les interactions des particules pour expliquer les propriétés des solides, liquides et gaz.

##### Expliquer la dilatation thermique par le mouvement et les interactions des particules

[explainThermalExpansionThroughParticleMotionAndInteractions.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/skills/explainThermalExpansionThroughParticleMotionAndInteractions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Heating often changes the average distances between particles, not the sizes of the molecules themselves.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi la dilatation change surtout les distances entre particules et non leur taille.

##### Relier le mouvement des particules aux variations de température

[relateParticleMotionToTemperatureChanges.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/molecularPhysics/particleModelOfMatter/skills/relateParticleMotionToTemperatureChanges.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using an animation, explain why average particle motion generally becomes more vigorous when heated.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Relie le chauffage aux changements du mouvement habituel des particules.

### Optique

Groups: 5 · Skills: 11

[optics.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/optics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Optics studies the propagation of light, image formation, and the interaction of light rays with surfaces, water, and lenses. The broader electromagnetic radiation spectrum is classified separately.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment la lumière visible se propage, se réfléchit, se réfracte et forme des images.

#### Lumière et ombres

Skills: 3

[lightAndShadows.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightAndShadows/lightAndShadows.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Obstacles and the source's position determine a shadow's appearance, direction, and size; a model enables qualitative predictions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment la disposition des objets et des sources lumineuses crée des ombres.

##### Expliquer comment se forme une ombre

[explainHowAShadowForms.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightAndShadows/skills/explainHowAShadowForms.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate a shadow to the blocking of light by an opaque object.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment un objet opaque bloque la lumière et forme une ombre.

##### Prévoir les changements de taille d'une ombre

[predictChangesInShadowSize.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightAndShadows/skills/predictChangesInShadowSize.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine how changing their relative positions affects shadow size.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment déplacer une source lumineuse ou un objet modifie la taille de l'ombre.

##### Prévoir la position d'une ombre

[predictThePositionOfAShadow.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightAndShadows/skills/predictThePositionOfAShadow.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Predict where a shadow forms given the positions of the source and object.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Prévois de quel côté d'un objet son ombre apparaîtra.

#### Réflexion de la lumière

Skills: 2

[lightReflection.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightReflection/lightReflection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A surface changes the direction of a light ray; mirrors provide a visible model of this behavior.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment la lumière change de direction lorsqu'elle rencontre une surface réfléchissante.

##### Prévoir la direction d'un rayon réfléchi

[predictTheDirectionOfAReflectedRay.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightReflection/skills/predictTheDirectionOfAReflectedRay.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** According to the law of reflection, the angle between the ray and the surface normal is the same for incident and reflected rays.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Prévois les angles de réflexion par rapport à la normale à une surface.

##### Reconnaître la réflexion de la lumière

[recognizeLightReflection.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightReflection/skills/recognizeLightReflection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify situations in which light returns from a surface.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais les situations où la lumière rebondit sur une surface.

#### Sources lumineuses et visibilité

Skills: 3

[lightSourcesAndVisibility.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightSourcesAndVisibility/lightSourcesAndVisibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An object is visible when light from it reaches the eye; a light source and an illuminated surface play different roles.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre pourquoi certains objets émettent de la lumière tandis que d'autres sont visibles grâce à la lumière réfléchie.

##### Classer les sources de lumière naturelles et artificielles

[classifyNaturalAndArtificialLightSources.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightSourcesAndVisibility/skills/classifyNaturalAndArtificialLightSources.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Group light sources according to their origin.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais les sources de lumière naturelles et celles fabriquées par les humains.

##### Distinguer une source lumineuse d'un objet éclairé

[distinguishALightSourceFromAnIlluminatedBody.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightSourcesAndVisibility/skills/distinguishALightSourceFromAnIlluminatedBody.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize a body that emits light and one that reflects it.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue un objet qui émet de la lumière d'un objet qu'elle éclaire.

##### Expliquer la condition pour qu'un objet soit visible

[explainTheConditionForAnObjectToBeVisible.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/lightSourcesAndVisibility/skills/explainTheConditionForAnObjectToBeVisible.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the need for light from an object to reach the eye.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique pourquoi nous ne voyons un objet que lorsque la lumière qui en provient atteint l'œil.

#### Réfraction et lentilles

Skills: 2

[refractionAndLenses.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/refractionAndLenses/refractionAndLenses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Moving between media and the shape of a lens affect ray direction and image formation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment la lumière dévie en passant entre différents matériaux et à travers des lentilles.

##### Distinguer les lentilles convergentes et divergentes

[distinguishConvergingAndDivergingLenses.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/refractionAndLenses/skills/distinguishConvergingAndDivergingLenses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use a simulation to observe how different lenses change the directions of light rays passing through them.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les lentilles qui rapprochent les rayons lumineux et celles qui les écartent.

##### Expliquer la réfraction à la frontière entre deux milieux

[explainLightRefractionAtTheBoundaryBetweenMedia.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/refractionAndLenses/skills/explainLightRefractionAtTheBoundaryBetweenMedia.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** When light passes between media with different optical properties, its speed changes and, at oblique incidence, so does the direction of the light wave.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment la lumière peut changer de direction à la frontière entre deux milieux.

#### Transparence

Skills: 1

[transparency.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/transparency/transparency.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Transparency characterizes the transmission, absorption, and scattering of visible light by a material and its ability to transmit an image.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les matériaux diffèrent par la quantité et la netteté de la lumière qu'ils transmettent.

##### Classer les matériaux selon leur transparence

[classifyMaterialsByTransparency.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/optics/transparency/skills/classifyMaterialsByTransparency.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish transparent, translucent, and opaque materials by their ability to transmit light and form a clear image through the material.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue les matériaux transparents, translucides et opaques.

### Rayonnement

Groups: 2 · Skills: 5

[radiation.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/radiation/radiation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Radiation describes energy transfer from a source through space, including invisible parts of the electromagnetic spectrum and their interaction with matter. Geometric image formation with light belongs to Optics.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore le rayonnement électromagnétique et ses interactions avec la matière.

#### Rayonnement électromagnétique

Skills: 3

[electromagneticRadiation.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/radiation/electromagneticRadiation/electromagneticRadiation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Radio waves, infrared, visible, and ultraviolet radiation are different regions of the electromagnetic spectrum.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre les parties visibles et invisibles du spectre électromagnétique.

##### Distinguer le rayonnement électromagnétique visible de l'invisible

[distinguishVisibleFromInvisibleElectromagneticRadiation.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/radiation/electromagneticRadiation/skills/distinguishVisibleFromInvisibleElectromagneticRadiation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use lamp light, infrared radiation, and radio waves to demonstrate that not all radiation can be detected by the eye.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais que les ondes radio et le rayonnement infrarouge sont invisibles à l'œil humain.

##### Expliquer la propagation des ondes électromagnétiques sans air

[explainThePropagationOfElectromagneticWavesWithoutAir.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/radiation/electromagneticRadiation/skills/explainThePropagationOfElectromagneticWavesWithoutAir.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use sunlight to explain why electromagnetic radiation can propagate through the vacuum of space.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique pourquoi les ondes électromagnétiques peuvent traverser le vide spatial.

##### Relier les types de rayonnement familiers au spectre électromagnétique

[relateFamiliarTypesOfRadiationToTheElectromagneticSpectrum.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/radiation/electromagneticRadiation/skills/relateFamiliarTypesOfRadiationToTheElectromagneticSpectrum.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Radio waves, infrared, visible, and ultraviolet radiation occupy positions in the spectrum according to frequency and wavelength; visibility does not determine their physical nature.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Place les types de rayonnement connus dans le spectre électromagnétique.

#### Rayonnement et matière

Skills: 2

[radiationAndMatter.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/radiation/radiationAndMatter/radiationAndMatter.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Materials can emit, reflect, transmit, or absorb energy; the outcomes depend on the type of radiation and the properties of matter.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les matériaux absorbent, émettent, réfléchissent ou transmettent le rayonnement.

##### Distinguer l'émission d'énergie de la réflexion de lumière reçue

[distinguishEnergyEmissionFromReflectionOfReceivedLight.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/radiation/radiationAndMatter/skills/distinguishEnergyEmissionFromReflectionOfReceivedLight.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using the Sun and Moon, explain that a source emits energy while an illuminated body can reflect it.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue la lumière émise par une source de celle réfléchie par un objet.

##### Expliquer le chauffage par absorption du rayonnement

[explainHeatingThroughRadiationAbsorption.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/radiation/radiationAndMatter/skills/explainHeatingThroughRadiationAbsorption.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using two surfaces in sunlight, relate differences in heating to energy absorption.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique pourquoi différentes surfaces ne chauffent pas de la même façon sous le même rayonnement.

### Thermodynamique

Groups: 4 · Skills: 15

[thermodynamics.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/thermodynamics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Thermal processes describe changes in temperature, energy transfer, and transitions between states of matter. Macroscopic observations are distinguished from particle-level explanations in the neighboring Domain.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore la température, le chauffage, les transferts d’énergie et les changements d’état.

#### Mécanismes de transfert thermique

Skills: 5

[heatTransferMechanisms.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/heatTransferMechanisms/heatTransferMechanisms.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Thermal energy is transferred through particle interactions, liquid or gas motion, or electromagnetic radiation. Several mechanisms may act simultaneously in a single process.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment la chaleur se transmet dans la matière, par les fluides en mouvement et par rayonnement.

##### Expliquer la conduction comme transfert d’énergie dans la matière

[explainConductionAsEnergyTransferThroughMatter.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/heatTransferMechanisms/skills/explainConductionAsEnergyTransferThroughMatter.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using a metal spoon heated in hot water, explain energy transfer without bulk movement of the entire substance.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique la conduction thermique sans mouvement global de la matière.

##### Expliquer la convection comme transfert d’énergie par écoulement

[explainConvectionAsEnergyTransferByFluidFlow.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/heatTransferMechanisms/skills/explainConvectionAsEnergyTransferByFluidFlow.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Convection carries thermal energy with macroscopic motion of a liquid or gas; distinguish it from conduction without bulk material flow.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais comment les liquides et les gaz en mouvement transportent de l’énergie thermique.

##### Expliquer le transfert thermique par rayonnement

[explainRadiativeHeatTransfer.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/heatTransferMechanisms/skills/explainRadiativeHeatTransfer.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using heat from the Sun or fire, demonstrate energy transfer by electromagnetic waves without contact or moving air.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment le rayonnement électromagnétique transfère de la chaleur sans milieu matériel.

##### Identifier le mécanisme de transfert thermique dans une situation physique

[identifyTheHeatTransferMechanismFromAPhysicalSituation.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/heatTransferMechanisms/skills/identifyTheHeatTransferMechanismFromAPhysicalSituation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** For a hot spoon, heated water, or sunlight, select and justify conduction, convection, radiation, or a combination of them. This is an integrative competency, not three separate tests combined in one task.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Détermine quels processus de transfert thermique agissent dans une situation donnée.

##### Prévoir le sens du transfert thermique

[predictTheDirectionOfHeatTransfer.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/heatTransferMechanisms/skills/predictTheDirectionOfHeatTransfer.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** In the absence of external work, heat spontaneously flows from a warmer body to a colder one until thermal equilibrium is reached.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Prévois le sens de transfert de l’énergie thermique entre des objets à différentes températures.

#### Changements d’état

Skills: 4

[phaseTransitions.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/phaseTransitions/phaseTransitions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Melting, freezing, evaporation, and condensation link thermal conditions to changes of state of the same substance.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment le chauffage et le refroidissement peuvent changer l’état physique d’une substance.

##### Distinguer évaporation et ébullition

[distinguishEvaporationFromBoiling.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/phaseTransitions/skills/distinguishEvaporationFromBoiling.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Boiling produces vapor bubbles throughout the volume of a liquid, whereas evaporation occurs at its surface.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue les bulles formées lors de l’ébullition de l’évaporation en surface.

##### Distinguer la fonte de la glace du gel de l’eau

[distinguishMeltingFromFreezingOfWater.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/phaseTransitions/skills/distinguishMeltingFromFreezingOfWater.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Melting changes a substance from solid to liquid, while freezing is the reverse; both are phase transitions of the same substance.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue la fonte de la glace de la solidification de l’eau liquide.

##### Expliquer la condensation

[explainCondensation.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/phaseTransitions/skills/explainCondensation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Condensation is the transition of matter from gas to liquid, including the formation of droplets from water vapor.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais le passage d’un gaz à l’état liquide par condensation.

##### Expliquer l’évaporation

[explainEvaporation.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/phaseTransitions/skills/explainEvaporation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaporation is the transition of particles from the surface of a liquid into the gas phase and can occur without boiling.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment un liquide peut s’évaporer à sa surface sans bouillir.

#### Température et chauffage

Skills: 4

[temperatureAndHeating.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/temperatureAndHeating/temperatureAndHeating.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Temperature characterizes thermal state but is not the same as a subjective feeling of warmth or cold; heating and cooling are changes of state.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à distinguer la mesure de température de la sensation de chaleur.

##### Comparer les températures des objets

[compareObjectsTemperatures.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/temperatureAndHeating/skills/compareObjectsTemperatures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Temperature characterizes a body's thermal state; valid comparisons rely on measurements, not the intensity of subjective warmth.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les températures à l’aide d’instruments plutôt que du toucher seul.

##### Distinguer température et sensation de chaleur

[distinguishTemperatureFromTheSensationOfWarmth.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/temperatureAndHeating/skills/distinguishTemperatureFromTheSensationOfWarmth.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why the sensation of touch is not always an accurate measure of temperature.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique pourquoi deux objets à la même température peuvent sembler différents au toucher.

##### Reconnaître le refroidissement

[recognizeCooling.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/temperatureAndHeating/skills/recognizeCooling.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A decrease in temperature can accompany energy transfer to the surroundings or changes in a system's physical state.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais le refroidissement comme une modification physique de l’état thermique.

##### Reconnaître le chauffage

[recognizeHeating.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/temperatureAndHeating/skills/recognizeHeating.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An increase in temperature reflects a change in thermal state, but energy input does not always increase temperature during a phase transition.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais les changements de l’état thermique lors du chauffage.

#### Isolation thermique

Skills: 2

[thermalInsulation.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/thermalInsulation/thermalInsulation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Insulating materials slow down energy transfer but do not create energy themselves; this differs from describing the three mechanisms of heat exchange.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment l’isolation ralentit le transfert de chaleur.

##### Comparer les propriétés isolantes des matériaux

[compareMaterialsThermalInsulationProperties.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/thermalInsulation/skills/compareMaterialsThermalInsulationProperties.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine from experimental results which material slows heat transfer more effectively.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les matériaux selon leur capacité à réduire les transferts de chaleur indésirables.

##### Choisir un matériau pour maintenir la température

[selectAMaterialForMaintainingTemperature.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/thermodynamics/thermalInsulation/skills/selectAMaterialForMaintainingTemperature.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose an insulator for a simple everyday task and justify the choice using the material's properties.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Choisis un matériau isolant pour répondre à un besoin concret de maintien de température.

### Ondes

Groups: 4 · Skills: 23

[waves.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/waves.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Oscillations produce recurring disturbances that can propagate through water, air, and other media. Sound is one manifestation, while wave patterns are visible on the surface of water.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les vibrations, le son et la propagation et les interactions des perturbations ondulatoires.

#### Acoustique

Skills: 8

[acoustics.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/acoustics/acoustics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Loudness, pitch, and the propagation of sound through a medium are related to oscillation properties; auditory experiences can be explored with safe simulations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les vibrations et la propagation du son influencent ce que nous entendons.

##### Comparer l'intensité sonore perçue

[compareTheLoudnessOfSounds.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/acoustics/skills/compareTheLoudnessOfSounds.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Loudness is the perception of sound intensity and also depends on frequency and hearing sensitivity; compare it independently of pitch.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare la force apparente des sons sans confondre volume sonore et hauteur.

##### Distinguer sons aigus et graves

[distinguishHighPitchedFromLowPitchedSounds.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/acoustics/skills/distinguishHighPitchedFromLowPitchedSounds.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Pitch is primarily related to the frequency of sound oscillations, not amplitude, which affects intensity.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais les sons aigus et graves grâce à leur fréquence.

##### Expliquer l'écho comme une réflexion du son

[explainAnEchoAsSoundReflection.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/acoustics/skills/explainAnEchoAsSoundReflection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using an echo in an empty room, recognize a returning sound wave after it interacts with a surface.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique qu'un écho est une onde sonore réfléchie par une surface.

##### Expliquer le lien entre intensité perçue et amplitude

[explainHowSoundLoudnessDependsOnOscillationAmplitude.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/acoustics/skills/explainHowSoundLoudnessDependsOnOscillationAmplitude.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** All else being equal, a greater sound-pressure amplitude means greater intensity, although perceived loudness also depends on frequency.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Relie une plus grande amplitude sonore à l'intensité tout en tenant compte de la perception.

##### Expliquer la dépendance de la hauteur du son à la fréquence

[explainHowSoundPitchDependsOnOscillationFrequency.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/acoustics/skills/explainHowSoundPitchDependsOnOscillationFrequency.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** All else being equal, a higher sound frequency corresponds to a higher pitch; it is not the same as increased loudness.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Relie une fréquence sonore plus élevée à une hauteur perçue plus aiguë.

##### Expliquer l'atténuation du son avec la distance

[explainSoundAttenuationWithDistance.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/acoustics/skills/explainSoundAttenuationWithDistance.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** As a wave spreads from a localized source, its energy is generally distributed over an increasing area, reducing intensity; absorption also affects sound levels.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi un son s'affaiblit généralement quand on s'éloigne de sa source.

##### Expliquer le changement de hauteur dû au mouvement relatif source-auditeur

[explainTheChangeInPerceivedPitchDuringRelativeMotionOfSourceAndListener.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/acoustics/skills/explainTheChangeInPerceivedPitchDuringRelativeMotionOfSourceAndListener.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** For an unchanged sound emitted by a source, explain the Doppler effect: the frequency heard by the observer is higher as the source approaches and lower as it moves away. Do not confuse this frequency change with loudness or engine revolutions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore pourquoi une source sonore en mouvement modifie la hauteur perçue.

##### Reconnaître la propagation du son dans un milieu

[recognizeSoundTransmissionThroughAMedium.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/acoustics/skills/recognizeSoundTransmissionThroughAMedium.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Sound requires an elastic material medium, in which pressure or deformation oscillations pass between adjacent parts of matter; mechanical sound does not propagate in a vacuum.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique pourquoi le son a besoin d'un milieu où les vibrations se propagent.

#### Oscillations

Skills: 4

[oscillations.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/oscillations/oscillations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Repetitive motion around a given state allows vibration, periodicity, and sound sources to be described.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment un mouvement répété produit des oscillations et des sources sonores.

##### Détecter les vibrations d'une source sonore

[detectVibrationsOfASoundSource.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/oscillations/skills/detectVibrationsOfASoundSource.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the oscillating part of a system that generates a sound disturbance, as distinct from components that merely transmit vibration onward.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Identifie la partie d'un objet qui vibre réellement pour produire du son.

##### Reconnaître un mouvement oscillatoire

[recognizeOscillatoryMotion.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/oscillations/skills/recognizeOscillatoryMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Oscillation is a change in a physical state around equilibrium that may recur; not every motion involving reversals is harmonic oscillation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais lorsqu'un état physique oscille autour de l'équilibre.

##### Reconnaître la périodicité des oscillations

[recognizeThePeriodicityOfOscillations.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/oscillations/skills/recognizeThePeriodicityOfOscillations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A periodic oscillation repeats a physical state at equal time intervals; not every motion that changes direction is periodic.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais une oscillation qui se répète à intervalles réguliers.

##### Relier le son à la vibration

[relateSoundToVibration.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/oscillations/skills/relateSoundToVibration.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Sound arises when an oscillating source disturbs an elastic medium; oscillation without a medium does not produce a mechanical sound wave.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Relie une source vibrante à la perturbation sonore qu'elle produit.

#### Phénomènes ondulatoires

Skills: 5

[wavePhenomena.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/wavePhenomena/wavePhenomena.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reflection, refraction, interference, diffraction, and resonance can occur in different kinds of physical waves.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les ondes se réfléchissent, se réfractent, se superposent, diffractent et résonnent.

##### Expliquer la résonance

[explainResonance.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/wavePhenomena/skills/explainResonance.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A periodic driving force near a system's natural frequency can substantially increase the amplitude of its oscillations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment une excitation périodique proche de la fréquence propre peut amplifier les oscillations.

##### Expliquer la diffraction des ondes

[explainWaveDiffraction.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/wavePhenomena/skills/explainWaveDiffraction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Waves may bend around obstacles or spread after passing through openings depending on relative dimensions and wavelength.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les ondes contournent des obstacles ou s'étalent après une ouverture.

##### Expliquer les interférences entre ondes

[explainWaveInterference.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/wavePhenomena/skills/explainWaveInterference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Superposed waves may reinforce or weaken the resulting disturbance depending on their phases.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais quand des ondes superposées se renforcent ou s'atténuent.

##### Expliquer la réflexion des ondes

[explainWaveReflection.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/wavePhenomena/skills/explainWaveReflection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Part of a disturbance may return from a boundary between media, changing its direction of propagation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment une onde peut repartir en arrière lorsqu'elle rencontre une frontière.

##### Expliquer la réfraction des ondes

[explainWaveRefraction.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/wavePhenomena/skills/explainWaveRefraction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A change in propagation speed at a boundary between media can change a wave's direction while the source frequency stays the same.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi la direction d'une onde peut changer si sa vitesse de propagation change.

#### Propriétés des ondes

Skills: 6

[waveProperties.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/waveProperties/waveProperties.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Waves have a direction of propagation, a characteristic rhythm, and a disturbance magnitude; observing water waves distinguishes wave propagation from transport of all the water.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les ondes se propagent et comment mesurer leurs propriétés.

##### Comparer les fréquences d'ondes selon leur rythme visible

[compareWaveFrequenciesByObservableRhythm.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/waveProperties/skills/compareWaveFrequenciesByObservableRhythm.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** In two animations, identify which produces more recurring crests in the same amount of time.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les ondes selon le nombre de cycles dans un même temps.

##### Distinguer l'oscillation de la source de la propagation de l'onde

[distinguishSourceOscillationFromWavePropagation.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/waveProperties/skills/distinguishSourceOscillationFromWavePropagation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An oscillating source creates a disturbance that propagates through a medium, while the medium's particles do not necessarily move along with the wavefront.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue une source qui vibre de la perturbation qui s'en éloigne.

##### Distinguer transfert d'énergie et transport de matière par une onde

[distinguishWaveEnergyTransferFromMatterTransport.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/waveProperties/skills/distinguishWaveEnergyTransferFromMatterTransport.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A wave carries energy without necessarily transporting the entire medium over the corresponding distance.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment une onde transfère de l'énergie sans transporter tout le milieu.

##### Expliquer l'amplitude d'une onde

[explainWaveAmplitude.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/waveProperties/skills/explainWaveAmplitude.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Amplitude is the greatest deviation of a physical quantity from its equilibrium value, not the wave's frequency.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends l'amplitude comme l'écart maximal par rapport à l'équilibre.

##### Expliquer la vitesse d'une onde

[explainWaveSpeed.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/waveProperties/skills/explainWaveSpeed.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Wave speed describes the propagation of a disturbance and differs from the motion of particles within the medium.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue la vitesse de propagation d'une onde du mouvement des particules du milieu.

##### Expliquer la longueur d'onde

[explainWavelength.data.ts](../../../content/physics/data/skills/waves/waveProperties/skills/explainWavelength.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Wavelength is the distance between adjacent points at the same phase of the disturbance, such as two successive crests.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais la longueur d'onde comme la distance entre des points en phase d'une onde.
